chapter: New Orleans and the Robichaux band
title: Leaving Robichaux and a week with Ernie Fields
summary: He left Robichaux in 1937, did the boat again in 1938, then joined Ernie Fields in Tucson for about a week.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: well what happened you left Joe Robichaux you played with that band for a while

I left Joe Robichaux uh in 1937 right and I went back with Sidney Desvane back on the boat in 1938 uh when I came back uh from the boat uh the very day I I came back to New Orleans there was a a telegram there to from Ernie Fields out of Oklahoma to join the band in Tucson Arizona and I took a train out that night and uh joined Ernie Fields about three days afterwards in Tucson Arizona
so alright so then you played were there any fields for how long George?
alright it was a very short time about a week
